content.short: DeForm helps you build an onchain allowlist, airdrop, or CRM.
content.description: DeForm offers onchain forms to build an allowlist, execute an airdrop, or manage CRM data on the blockchain. These Web3 forms help you cut through spam, automate the distribution of digital asset rewards, and strengthen your onchain marketing. By centralizing data collection, entry management, and reward logistics in a single tool, DeForm makes it easier to run compliant campaigns and maintain engaging, verifiable interactions with your audience across campaigns.
content.meta: DeForm is the best way to build an onchain allowlist, airdrop, or CRM. Discover DeForm and other Infrastructure Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
